phase_plan.beta: Parfit verifies v281-v360 and v361-v370 closeout truth, v401-v420 handoff truth, live runner state, and 10000-step bounded CLI scope.

phase_plan.omega: Parfit hands off the next bounded phase, or prepares the v401-v420 closeout at v420.

terminal_profile.purpose: Keep main and integrated terminals anchored to the authoritative worktree before runner, git, or automation actions.

goal_mode.packet_goal: Complete v401-v420 through v420 closeout using one active phase, durable CLI receipts, forward-only publication, and no v421 launch.
goal_mode.phase_goal: Complete v407 with valid Arby, Kimi, and Aster Vale receipts, then create a refined v408 handoff without blurring phase boundaries.
goal_mode.slash_goal_policy: Use /goal in interactive Codex surfaces when available; in non-interactive receipt runners, include the same objective as a durable goal contract.
goal_mode.anti_pattern: Do not collapse v407-v420 into one monolithic receipt run.

advisory_refinement.late_reply_policy: Late advisory replies can seed later phases, but cannot block or replace Arby/Kimi/Aster Vale receipts.
